framing: large head-and-shoulders close-ups from mid-chest up, like comic book close-up panels: the whole head and BOTH shoulders fully drawn with wide empty space on every side, never cut off at the left or right side; only the bottom edge is a straight horizontal cut at mid-chest
note: Bart 11-12: close-ups need their shoulders (half were cut off in the 4x2 sheets): 2x2 sheets, wide cells.
